```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
play_by_play <- read_csv('play_by_play.csv')
```

```{r}
# Converting qtr to a factor so that I can color them by quarter in the histogram
play_by_play <- play_by_play %>% mutate(across(qtr, ~factor(., levels = c(0:9))))
```

```{r}
# I only want to look at plays that made points
play_by_play <- play_by_play %>% filter((scoring_play == TRUE) & ((qtr == 1) | (qtr == 2) | (qtr == 3) | (qtr == 4)))
```

```{r}
play_by_play <- play_by_play %>% filter(!(score_value == 0))
```

```{r}
colnames(play_by_play)[colnames(play_by_play) == "qtr"] <- "Quarter"
```


```{r}
# fig.width = 6, fig.height = 2.5
# for next time, facet wrap by whether or not the team lost? or by specific basket made (3 pointer, layup, etc)?
play_by_play %>% mutate(score_value = case_when(score_value == 1 ~ "1 Pointer", score_value == 2 ~ "2 Pointer", score_value == 3 ~ "3 Pointer")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = start_game_seconds_remaining, fill = Quarter)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 150) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues") +
  theme_minimal(paper = "#1E1E1E", ink = "white", accent = "#4fc3f7") +
  ggtitle("Distribution of Scoring Across Quarters by Points") +
  facet_wrap(~ score_value) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  xlab("Seconds Remaining in Game") +
  ylab("Count")

ggsave("loveDataPlotDarkMode.png", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
pointsTable <- play_by_play %>% group_by(game_id) %>% dplyr::summarize(total_points = sum(score_value), total_1 = sum(score_value == 1), total_2 = sum(score_value == 2), total_3 = sum(score_value == 3), avg_1 = (total_1 / (total_1 + total_2 + total_3)), avg_2 = ((total_2 * 2)/ (total_1 + total_2 + total_3)), avg_3 = ((total_3 * 3)/ (total_1 + total_2 + total_3)))
```

```{r}
head(pointsTable)
```

```{r}
ggplot(pointsTable, aes(x = total_1)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```

```{r}
median(pointsTable$total_1)
median(pointsTable$avg_1)
mean(pointsTable$avg_1)
```

```{r}
median(pointsTable$total_2)
median(pointsTable$avg_2)
mean(pointsTable$avg_2)
```

```{r}
median(pointsTable$total_3)
median(pointsTable$avg_3)
mean(pointsTable$avg_3)
```

```{r}
pointsDF <- data.frame(points = c(1,2,3), median_proportion = c(median(pointsTable$avg_1), median(pointsTable$avg_2), median(pointsTable$avg_3)), median_total = c(median(pointsTable$total_1), median(pointsTable$total_2), median(pointsTable$total_3)))
```

pointsDF
